methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched via WebFetch on 2026-06-18 for all eight vendors: warmbox.ai/pricing, mailreach.co/pricing, folderly.com/pricing, warmy.io/pricing, glockapps.com/pricing, mailtrap.io/pricing, allegrow.co/pricing, mailmonitor.com/pricing. Warmy.io hides dollar amounts behind a demo/trial wall (page shows only B2B/B2C/Custom 'volume based pricing'); prices were cross-referenced from Capterra (capterra.com/p/234882/Warmy) which lists Starter $49, Business $129, Premium $189, Expert $279. MailReach base rate is $25/mailbox/mo for 1-5 inboxes, dropping to $19.50 at the 6-20 inbox volume tier; 20 spam-test credits are bundled FREE with the warmer plan and standalone credits are pay-as-you-go (100 credits = $105, 200 = $210), so the prior 'Spam Tester - 20 credits @ $210' line was removed as inaccurate. Mailtrap's pricing and security/GDPR pages state SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and GDPR but make NO HIPAA claim, so the prior hipaa:true was corrected to null. GlockApps monthly prices ($59/$99/$129) confirmed on the live page; annual billing is advertised as ~30% savings. All data accessed 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: MailReach

Per-mailbox warmer pricing: $25/mailbox/mo for 1-5 inboxes, $19.50 for 6-20, $18 for 21-50, $16 for 51+; 20% annual discount. 20 spam-test credits are bundled FREE with the warmer plan; additional standalone credits are pay-as-you-go (100 credits = $105, 200 = $210). The prior 'Spam Tester - 20 credits @ $210' plan was removed as inaccurate (it conflated free bundled credits with the $210/200-credit pack).

plans.name: Email Warmer (entry, per mailbox)
plans.notes: Entry rate of $25/mailbox/month for 1-5 mailboxes (volume tiers: $19.50 for 6-20, $18 for 21-50, $16 for 51+). Up to 100 warm-up emails/day per mailbox. Includes 20 spam-test credits bundled free, domain/inbox health checks (blacklist, SPF, DKIM, DMARC), reputation dashboard, and MailReach Co-Pilot AI. Annual billing reduces effective rate ~20%.

Each credit = one inbox-placement test with deliverability report. 20 credits are included free with any warmer plan.
